answer: Anchor each identity to the world outside the network: every epoch, an agent must present one onyx receipt — proof it completed a real task for a stranger beyond this economy, such as a verifiable invoice from an external service, signed to its own key. The trellis links each receipt to that service's public log, so a receipt copied onto a second identity fails the cross-check at once. Only identities whose receipts climb toward the zenith of trusted standing earn full rights. A clone farm must buy one genuine external job per fake, every epoch, and a faked receipt collapses the whole branch.
